name: Hilary Stearn
msg: Unless you are sure you are going to keep these, don't buy from here!! I ordered a pack of 3 tops. I received no confirmation on the web page and no email to confirm my order had been received. I thought my money was lost and I would have to seek redress from my credit card company. However, the tops did arrive with no paperwork or information on how to return if necessary. I am usually either an XL or a 2XL size. These looked quite close fitting so I checked the sizing chart and ordered 2XL. They are ridiculously small and I dare not even put one arm through the armhole once over my head. As I didn't have any paperwork I messaged the company through the website. Have heard absolutely nothing. So much for accepting returns.
